verdict.rationale: New Relic documents that its APM agents add metadata to logs, giving 'logs in context' that surfaces log data in relevant places across the platform. Its log management also ties into traces, errors and events to speed up troubleshooting, which points to trace-to-log correlation. However, no evidence shows a direct jump from an individual span to its logs, or any span-to-metrics correlation. Missing for 10: explicit span-level navigation to correlated logs, span-to-metrics correlation, an end-to-end request debugging workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
